notes.title: Major update: 1-turn kill
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/74dd69d604aed34c0b046ea9e5e43d2153707a63.png"][/img][/p][p]The new Alpha demo will be available only between [u]25-31 August[/u]. [/p][p]So try it out fast or you'll have to wait for the next open window![/p][p][/p][h2]"1-turn kill" full focus[/h2][p][/p][p]Previously the game was designed as a potential base building / wargame multiplayer.[/p][p]Now we go [u]all in on the single player roguelike brokenness[/u] which is what makes us unique![/p][p][/p][h3][b]💥 "On a knife's edge" game balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New passive system (Traits) = whole faction blanket upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Major cost reduction for super speedy deployment[/p][/*][*][p]Brokenness can be reach by default with in-game building upgrades (like a tech tree)[/p][/*][*][p]More than 1 reward per location possible, especially high risk/reward paths[/p][/*][*][p]Last few battles can win in less than 5 turns! (feels impossible, challenging but doable!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]⭐ Onboarding experience revamp[/b][/h3][list][*][p]10-20 min max to finish the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Help player "get" the game brokenness immediately[/p][/*][*][p]Separate tutorial out from the campaign to replay[/p][/*][*][p]More in-context tutorial images[/p][/*][*][p]Gentler difficulty ramping up for player[/p][/*][*][p]Feeling of progression is strong and clear[/p][/*][*][p]Less story images[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Next step[/h2][list][*][p]More visual effects for game feel feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Full UI revamp[/p][/*][*][p]Environment art upgrades[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See you at our demo and [url="https://discord.com/invite/YuPbsJegTd"]feedback[/url]. Thanks![/p][p]Ahsaurus team 🤘[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/4c2b8a5c84662ea61b7d8925a7ada1e60e5d9ea9.png"][/img][/p]
